text: Suggested next slice: "Cancel Reservation" — this screen's mockup already shows a Delete button per row, but nothing in the model handles it yet. Since there's already a rule that a user can only hold one reservation at a time, cancelling is what lets them book again, so it's the natural next step. A close second: "Edit Reservation" for the Edit button, if changing an existing booking (not just cancelling it) matters for this flow.
author: wdyt
